name: GLOBE_TO_REGION
timing_law: dur=S/V clamped 2.5-6 s; settle >=0.3 s before key noun
variant_axes: approach bearing; pitch 0-60; highlight fill|outline-pulse|glow; label side

name: ZOOM_TO_FOCUS
timing_law: 1.5-3 s; pin lands on noun onset -0.2..0 s
variant_axes: pin style; label leader angle; zoom depth

name: HIGHLIGHT_HOLD_PUSH
timing_law: hold = beat length; elements 12-20 frames ease-out
variant_axes: push target; accent colour; secondary label

name: ROUTE_JOURNEY
timing_law: draw time = clause duration; head reaches destination on destination noun
variant_axes: solid|dashed|arc; vehicle icon; trail fade

name: ARMY_ARROWS
timing_law: arrow onset on movement verb (lead 0-0.2 s); growth 1-2.5 s
variant_axes: arrow taper/colour by side; split/merge arrows; curvature

name: UNIT_BLOCKS_MOVE
camera: pan to keep centroid of moving units
timing_law: move dur = clause; stagger 3-6 frames per unit
variant_axes: NATO|historic block style; formation; facing

name: FORCES_INTRO
timing_law: one side per clause; counters count up over 0.6-1.0 s
variant_axes: side-by-side|sequential; counter style

name: CLASH
primitives (local IDs; map to Area-1 cat: MAP.FRONTLINE FX.SMOKE_FIRE FX.EXPLOSION_FLASH FX.SHAKE SFX.HIT SFX.AMBIENT(battle)
timing_law: hit FX frame-locked to SFX (|offset|<=1 frame)
variant_axes: smoke density; flash colour; casualty counter

name: TERRITORY_CHANGE
timing_law: morph 0.8-2 s starting on change verb
variant_axes: sweep direction; flash on capture; hatch for occupied

name: TIMELAPSE_RUN
camera: reframe to active region every 10-60 s
timing_law: rate param (years/s); label fade 0.3 s
variant_axes: rate curve; label density; era colour set

name: PERSON_INTRO
timing_law: card in on name onset -0.2 s; hold >= name+title read time
variant_axes: card frame style; side; B/W vs colour

name: STAT_CALLOUT
timing_law: count-up ends on number word
variant_axes: counter font; unit icon; ticker vs pop

name: SIZE_COMPARE
timing_law: drag 1.2-2 s; overlap reveal on comparison word
variant_axes: drag path; ghost vs solid; 2-3 comparators

name: DATA_MAP_REVEAL
timing_law: sweep 1-2 s; legend first (context before data)
variant_axes: sweep direction; classed vs continuous; dot vs fill

name: CHART_BUILD
timing_law: one series/element per sentence; allows 20-60 s holds
variant_axes: bar|line|area; annotation style

name: ENV_CONDITION
timing_law: FX ramps in over 0.5-1 s on condition noun
variant_axes: weather type; time of day; orbit dir

name: CHAPTER_CARD
timing_law: 1.5-3 s; music change on card in
variant_axes: typography lockup; transition type

name: HOOK_MONTAGE
primitives (local IDs; map to Area-1 cat: 3-5 sub-shots from other templates at 0.6-1.2 s; SFX.HIT SFX.RISER
timing_law: first visual change <=1 s; total 3-8 s
variant_axes: sub-shot selection; rhythm

name: QUOTE_DOCUMENT
timing_law: highlighter 8-12 frames per phrase as read
variant_axes: paper type; highlight colour

name: CAUSE_EFFECT_ON_MAP
timing_law: one link per clause
variant_axes: icon set; arrow style

name: RECAP_ZOOM_OUT
variant_axes: end card

name: SPLIT_COMPARE
variant_axes: split orientation
